info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Tax Advisory Management API
info.description: The Corporate Tax Advisory Management API enables businesses to update and manage their corporate tax advisory services efficiently. This endpoint supports the modification of key advisory details for clients, ensuring adherence to evolving tax regulations. Typical consumers include corporate financial teams and tax consultants who utilize this service to streamline advisory updates for better compliance and strategic planning. By enabling real-time updates, the API enhances the responsiveness of tax advisory services to the needs of corporate clients.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific corporate tax advisory resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the data being updated complies with the corporate finance regulations.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating corporate tax advisory details for the specified resource. This body allows for the modification of various attributes related to corporate tax strategies and recommendations pertinent to the entity involved.
